scope: Multilingual document understanding — native PDF, scanned PDF, DOCX, ZIP, tables, EN/FR/PT

pre_existing_failures.reason: Garbled Unicode in French date string — fails identically on baseline before changes

changes_implemented.rationale: Tesseract combined model covers all three required portal languages in one OCR pass. Language detection happens after OCR from the resulting text, making pre-OCR language detection a circular dependency.

changes_implemented.serialization: to_dict and from_dict updated for both classes
changes_implemented.fingerprint: content_fingerprint updated to include language field on pages and sections
changes_implemented.rationale: Tender documents mix languages across pages/sections. Document-level language tag loses per-section signal needed for mixed-language ToRs.

Populates language field on each page and section using existing detect_language(). Frozen dataclasses replaced (not mutated). Pages/sections below 20-token threshold keep language=None — correct, not a gap.

dedup_paths.mechanism: sha256(data) computed per path; _seen dict keyed by checksum; duplicate paths return copy with new filename but prior content
_seen_checksums dict keyed by snapshot.checksum; duplicate snapshots get re-stamped DocumentExtraction from prior; persisted and included in bundle

changes_implemented.duplicate_handling: Duplicates still appear in bundle with original identity — never silently discarded
changes_implemented.rationale: ZIP expansion produces separate Document rows for identical files. Without dedup each is re-extracted, wasting OCR time and producing redundant artifacts.
